parsed.description: One model run on one measure. Every property is required; optional values are null. This keeps the schema usable with every vendor's strict structured-output mode.

restatements.text: Bans demonstrating within 100 feet of a house of worship's entrance while scheduled religious services are taking place.

findings.quote: No person may demonstrate within 100 feet of the entrance of a house of worship during scheduled religious services.
findings.mechanism: Bans demonstrating within a specified distance of houses of worship during service times, restricting where speech and assembly can occur.

analysis.answer: Current law permits demonstrations on public sidewalks near houses of worship, restricted only by general noise and traffic ordinances. The proposed measure creates a specific 100-foot buffer zone around the entrances to houses of worship where demonstrations are banned during scheduled services.

Protesters will likely adapt by moving their demonstrations just beyond the 100-foot buffer or shifting their times to before or after scheduled services. Police will need to measure distances and verify service times when responding to calls.

The measure addresses the disruption of religious services and potential intimidation of attendees by protesters. The 100-foot buffer physically separates demonstrators from congregants entering or exiting, though this mechanism restricts speech in traditional public forums and may face First Amendment challenges.
Law enforcement gains discretion to interpret what behaviors constitute a 'demonstration'. Houses of worship gain the ability to activate the 100-foot buffer zone by scheduling religious services.

flags.note: The text does not define what specific actions or behaviors qualify as a demonstration.

gain.empty_reason: The measure establishes a restriction on demonstrations but does not expand any rights, benefits, or services tracked by the concerns.

items.text: The ability to freely assemble and demonstrate on public property within 100 feet of a house of worship's entrance during scheduled services.

changes.empty_reason: The measure does not affect any of the directional concerns.

items.text: The freedom to demonstrate on public sidewalks near houses of worship at any time, subject only to general noise and traffic rules.

forgo.empty_reason: The measure offers no gains on the tracked concern axes to forgo.
